correctness.rationale: The self-adjoint fixed-image space is canonically Sym^2(U), valid in characteristic two. Orthogonal image incidence gives Gaussian rank fibers and smooth rank strata. For each intersection rank-bound pair, an irreducible relative-Grassmannian incidence bundle surjects and has a dense full-rank stratum, yielding dimension D_n(n-j+i). All n+1 maximal rank components are distinct. The MacWilliams symmetric-form count from Lewis et al. is a standard verified input. Independent exact enumeration over prime and extension fields and for nonstandard bilinear forms matched every predicted rank fiber.

value.rationale: The result completely classifies a natural full zero-product locus of self-adjoint operator pairs: all components and every nonempty multiple intersection, every finite-field rank profile, and a Witt-independent asymptotic. It is uniform across dimension, prime-power field order, and bilinear-form type; the absence of Witt dependence contrasts sharply with the structurally related individually square-zero locus. The combined result gives natural geometric and arithmetic invariants, not an arbitrary small table.
